scientific_integrity: The divisor-sum parity criterion is proved directly from prime factorization. The odd-hypotenuse branch is reduced exactly to two classical Fermat descent obstructions: \(x^4+y^4=z^2\) has no positive solution, and no integer right triangle has nonzero square area. The finite checker is regression evidence only and is not used to establish the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is only a necessary condition for Dimitrov's equal-sigma MP(2,2) equation. It rules out odd common divisor sums and all primitive/coprime pairs, but it does not decide whether an imprimitive even-even solution exists.
title: An even-gcd obstruction for equal-sigma MP(2,2) pairs
